title: Independent DFT comparison of DQCS divalent-metal complexes
difficulty_reasons: The three systems are fixed, but the agent must independently select a defensible method, validate metal-complex state handling, and compare multiple conceptual-DFT observables.

paper.title: Unveiling multi-responsive colorimetric and fluorescent sensing behavior and DFT insights of a novel coumarin and 8-hydroxyquinoline conjugate for Cd2+, Co2+, and Ni2+ ions detection

data.description: Three 65-center XYZ files; Cd/Ni +2 singlet and Co +2 doublet.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-complex electronic observables, method, comparison, and limitations.
